demos.name: ContinuousSlider
demos.description: Continuous sliders allow users to select a value along a subjective range.

demos.name: SliderSizes
demos.description: For smaller slider, use the prop size="small".

demos.name: DiscreteSlider
demos.description: Discrete sliders can be adjusted to a specific value by referencing its value indicator.

demos.name: DiscreteSliderSteps
demos.description: You can change the default step increment.

demos.name: DiscreteSliderMarks
demos.description: You can have custom marks by providing a rich array to the marks prop.

demos.name: DiscreteSliderValues
demos.description: You can restrict the selectable values to those provided with the marks prop with step={null}.

demos.name: DiscreteSliderLabel
demos.description: You can force the thumb label to be always visible with valueLabelDisplay="on".

demos.name: RangeSlider
demos.description: The slider can be used to set the start and end of a range by supplying an array of values to the value prop.

demos.name: MinimumDistanceSlider
demos.description: You can enforce a minimum distance between values in the onChange event handler.

demos.name: InputSlider
demos.description: In this example, an input allows a discrete value to be set.
